title: Implement column CRUD operations on table model
description: Implement create, read, update, and delete operations for columns in the table data model.
acceptanceCriteria: User can add a new column to a table
User can edit existing column properties
User can remove a column from a table
Table reflects all column changes on canvas

evidence: src/hooks/useDiagram.ts — Added Column and createColumn imports; added addColumn(tableId, column), removeColumn(tableId, columnId), updateColumn(tableId, columnId, updates) to UseDiagramReturn interface and implementation. removeColumn cleans up referencing indexes and unique constraints.

src/components/TableNode.tsx — Added onAddColumn, onRemoveColumn, onUpdateColumn props to TableNodeProps; addColumn() calls onAddColumn(table.id, {...}), removeColumn() calls onRemoveColumn(table.id, columnId), updateColumnField() calls onUpdateColumn(table.id, columnId, updates).

src/components/DiagramCanvas.tsx — Added Column import; added onAddColumn/onRemoveColumn/onUpdateColumn to DiagramCanvasProps; passes all three through to each TableNode; restored TABLE_DEFAULT_WIDTH/TABLE_DEFAULT_HEIGHT constants.
src/App.tsx — Destructured addColumn/removeColumn/updateColumn from useDiagram(); added handleAddColumn/handleRemoveColumn/handleUpdateColumn handlers; passes all three to DiagramCanvas.

src/components/TableNode.test.tsx — Updated renderTableNode helper with new props; updated all column tests (name edit, data type change, nullable toggle, PK toggle, default value edit/clear, add column, remove column) to assert onUpdateColumn/onAddColumn/onRemoveColumn callbacks.
src/components/DiagramCanvas.test.tsx — Added onAddColumn/onRemoveColumn/onUpdateColumn props to all 4 DiagramCanvas render calls.
Implementation follows same CRUD pattern as existing index operations (addIndex/removeIndex/updateIndex).

All four acceptance criteria addressed: add column (addColumn), edit column properties (updateColumn), remove column (removeColumn), table reflects changes on canvas (unidirectional data flow via useDiagram state → TableNode re-render).
